name: Color Scheme Switcher
description: Provides a frontend API to switch between Light/Auto/Dark color schemes.
project_description: The Color Scheme Switcher (cosesi) module provides a frontend API and a placeable block to let visitors switch between Light, System (Auto), and Dark color schemes on a Drupal 11 site without a page reload. It injects an inline <style> and <script> early in <head> to set the CSS color-scheme property on :root and toggle a configurable CSS class on the <html> element (e.g. color-scheme-dark), minimising flash-of-unstyled-content. The visitor's choice is persisted in localStorage. Optionally, elements carrying a configurable "hide class" (e.g. color-scheme-only-dark) are hidden when the opposite scheme is active. The switcher block ships two widget types: Buttons (one button per state) and Dropdown (a popover). CSS variable name and the HTML classes for each state are configurable per active frontend theme via an admin form at /admin/appearance/cosesi-theme-settings (guarded by the 'administer themes' permission). Requires PHP >= 8.4 and Drupal core ^11.3; depends on the core config module. Not covered by the drupal.org security advisory policy (1.0.0-alpha1).
